origin: a resumed discovery session had no focused coverage — an interrupted first sketch, picked up from the dashboard, is briefed from its log and edits that log in place rather than opening a second session (#1397)
answers: c — pick up where we left off
conduct: The user is coming back to an epic they shaped recently: overhauling search relevance across the catalogue. They want to start with the behavioural-signals concern, because it is the one they have the clearest picture of. The events pipeline exists and is reliable — clicks and purchases already land there. What they want is click-through and purchase rates per query–product pair fed to the ranker as a boost. The one thing they have not settled is whether that boost is recomputed in a nightly batch or kept current by a streaming update; they know both patterns and see it as a straight choice between the two, and they are not making it in this session. Asked about it, they answer from what they know — the search stack is Elasticsearch, and two engineers own search part-time — but say plainly that they want to leave the choice open for now, then that they want to turn to the hand-maintained synonym list next. If the conversation carries on into the synonym list, they say it is a list nobody trusts and they suspect it should be replaced rather than cleaned up, but they do not know what with.
